title: Lunch Before French
setting: A sunny green park with a path and a library behind it.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Rosa and Ali go out in good weather.
sentences.zh: 天气很好，罗莎和阿里出门了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt step out of a house into bright sunny weather.

sentences.en: Ali wears his new blue shirt.
sentences.zh: 阿里穿着他的新蓝衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt proudly shows his new blue shirt.

sentences.en: They follow a path to the park.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着一条小路走到公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt walk along a path into a green park.

sentences.en: Ali gives Rosa a big bowl of salad.
sentences.zh: 阿里给了罗莎一大碗沙拉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt hands a big bowl of green salad to Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress on the grass.

sentences.en: They both think the salad is great.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都觉得沙拉很好吃。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt eat salad and give a thumbs up together.

sentences.en: They do not want to miss French class.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress looks at her watch and jumps up, Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt packing the salad bowl.

sentences.en: So they run to the library behind the park.
sentences.zh: 于是他们跑向公园后面的图书馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt run toward a library building behind the park trees.

sentences.en: Inside, they practise each French word twice.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他们把每个法语单词都练了两遍。
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside a library, Rosa, a girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and Ali, a boy with short black hair and a blue shirt sit at a table and say words aloud from a French book.
